title: The Horizon of Kepler Reach
author: Ulyana Underhill
blurb: Isandro Dravenmoor, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
